args.subject: Resume Template
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume template request email you sent. I was able to access the resume templates website (www.resume-templates.com) and the download links page, but when I tried to download the PDF template from https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf, the download was blocked by policy.

I can see the template is available at that URL, but I'm unable to directly download and send it to you. 

Would you like me to:
1. Try accessing the template through a different method?
2. Send you the website links so you can download it yourself?
3. Help you with something else regarding your resume?

Please let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
